senses.gloss: f. (contr. of רעיפ׳, v. Fl. to Levy, Talm. Dict. IV, p. 488; v. רְעָפִים) flat cake; in gen. bread.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:50">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 50</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 40:16">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XL, 16</cite>.—
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:7">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="K01186"><he>כְּרַךְ</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:11">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>חזי דאנא רִפְתָּא וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>ריפ׳</he>) see to it (that you remove the ashes carefully), for I want fine bread.
Sabb. 151ᵇ אקדים ליה ר׳, v. קְדַם; a. fr.—Pl. (m.) רִיפֵי.

<cite ref="Berakhot 42a:2">Ber. 42ᵃ</cite> top <he>תליסר ר׳ בני וכ׳</he> Ms. M. margin (ed. <he>ריפתי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) thirteen cakes each containing one third of a kab (Ar. <he>ריפי כעכי</he>).
